cases.purpose: Against a kernel state set up by the oracle (distinctive rate/backlog limits, no rules, then four known rules), audit status and status -V report the kernel's AUDIT_GET values, list-rules prints No rules for an empty set and the canonical text of the known rules in kernel list order, and none of the queries changes the kernel state (the fixture runs as a transient systemd service so that it is in the guest's initial PID namespace, which the kernel requires for audit control)
cases.oracle: An independent raw-netlink model (struct.pack/unpack of AUDIT_GET/AUDIT_SET/AUDIT_LIST_RULES/AUDIT_ADD_RULE/AUDIT_DEL_RULE against the guest kernel) as the oracle for kernel state, run as root in the initial namespaces of a KVM guest; the snapshot/restore of audit state is done by the same oracle
cases.comparison: audit status lines and the -V variables compared with the oracle's AUDIT_GET taken immediately before and after; list-rules text for the empty set and four oracle-installed rules; the oracle's status and rule dump before versus after the queries.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125

W=/run/w6-audit; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$W"
/usr/bin/cat >"$W/inner.sh" <<'INNER_EOF'
export HOME=/run/w6-audit PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin
cd "$HOME"
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
OR=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-audit-nl.py
nl() { /usr/bin/python3 -I "$OR" "$@"; }
jget() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.loads(sys.argv[1])[sys.argv[2]])' "$1" "$2"; }
stable() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); [d.pop(k) for k in ("lost","backlog","mask")]; print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))' "$1"; }
SNAP=$HOME/audit-snap.json
nl snapshot "$SNAP" >/dev/null || { echo "audit netlink unavailable: $(nl status)"; exit 1; }
trap 'nl restore "$SNAP" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT
nl flush >/dev/null
nl set enabled=1 failure=0 rate_limit=77 backlog_limit=4321 >/dev/null
stl() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); print("\n".join("%s=%d" % (k, d[k]) for k in ("enabled","pid","rate_limit","backlog_limit","lost","backlog","failure")))' "$1"; }

e1=$(stl "$o1"); e2=$(stl "$o2")
echo "status: rc=$rc equals-oracle=$([[ $out == "$e1" || $out == "$e2" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
while IFS= read -r l; do [[ $l == lost=* || $l == backlog=* ]] || echo "  $l"; done <<<"$out"
audit status -V qs >"$HOME/v.out"; rc=$?
echo "bind: rc=$rc enabled=$qs_enabled pid=$qs_pid rate_limit=$qs_rate_limit backlog_limit=$qs_backlog_limit failure=$qs_failure lost-ok=$([[ $qs_lost == "$(jget "$o1" lost)" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) backlog-ok=$([[ $qs_backlog == "$(jget "$o1" backlog)" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) stdout-empty=$([[ -s $HOME/v.out ]] && echo 0 || echo 1)"
out=$(audit list-rules); echo "empty-list: rc=$? out=[$out] kernel=$(nl rules)"
nl add '{"flags": 4, "action": 2, "syscalls": [2, 59], "fields": [[1, 1073741824, 2000]], "key": "mig-w6-a"}' >/dev/null
nl add '{"flags": 20, "action": 0, "syscalls": [57, 58], "fields": [[9, 1610612736, 1000], [104, 1073741824, 1]], "key": ""}' >/dev/null
nl add '{"flags": 0, "action": 2, "syscalls": [], "fields": [[12, 1073741824, 1100]], "key": "mig-w6-u"}' >/dev/null
nl add '{"flags": 5, "action": 2, "syscalls": [], "fields": [[12, 1073741824, 1300]], "key": ""}' >/dev/null
s1=$(stable "$(nl status)"); r1=$(nl rules)
out=$(audit list-rules); rc=$?
echo "known-list: rc=$rc"
while IFS= read -r l; do echo "  $l"; done <<<"$out"
audit status >/dev/null; audit status -V zz; audit list-rules >/dev/null
s2=$(stable "$(nl status)"); r2=$(nl rules)
echo "unchanged-by-queries: status=$([[ $s1 == "$s2" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) rules=$([[ $r1 == "$r2" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) kernel-rules=$(/usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.loads(sys.argv[1])))' "$r2")"

INNER_EOF
/usr/bin/systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --quiet "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$W/inner.sh"
rc=$?
/usr/bin/cp "$W/rec.tsv" /tmp/parity-case/rec.tsv 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/rm -rf "$W"
exit $rc
cases.stdout:
status: rc=0 equals-oracle=1
  enabled=1
  pid=0
  rate_limit=77
  backlog_limit=4321
  failure=0
bind: rc=0 enabled=1 pid=0 rate_limit=77 backlog_limit=4321 failure=0 lost-ok=1 backlog-ok=1 stdout-empty=1
empty-list: rc=0 out=[No rules] kernel=[]
known-list: rc=0
  -a always,user -F msgtype=1100 -k mig-w6-u
  -a never,exit -S fork -S vfork -F auid>=1000 -F success=1

cases.purpose: audit run registers itself as the audit daemon (the kernel reports its pid and enabled=1), receives the audit records of a fixture-run execve that matches an oracle-installed rule, decodes them into the TSV rows (pid, exe, key, syscall number, same-event CWD/EXECVE/PATH records) and deregisters its pid on exit (the fixture runs as a transient systemd service so that it is in the guest's initial PID namespace, which the kernel requires for audit control)

cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125

nl add '{"flags":4,"action":2,"syscalls":[59],"fields":[],"key":"mig-w6-ev"}' >/dev/null
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$HOME/nap"; exec 7<>"$HOME/nap"
nap() { read -t "$1" -u 7; }
ms() { echo $(( ${EPOCHREALTIME/./} / 1000 )); }
rec=$HOME/rec.tsv; t0=$(ms)
audit run -t 6 -o "$rec" >"$HOME/run.out" 2>"$HOME/run.err" &
rp=$!

/usr/bin/true & cp=$!; wait "$cp"
nap 0.5
wait "$rp"; rc=$?; t1=$(ms)
n=$(<"$HOME/run.out"); rows=0; while IFS= read -r _; do rows=$((rows+1)); done <"$rec"
echo "run: rc=$rc stderr-empty=$([[ -s $HOME/run.err ]] && echo 0 || echo 1) emitted-equals-rows=$([[ $n == "$rows" && $n -gt 0 ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) ended-by-deadline=$(( t1 - t0 >= 5000 ))"
echo "deregistered: pid=$(jget "$(nl status)" pid)"

/usr/bin/python3 -I - "$rec" "$cp" "$t0" "$t1" "$HOME" <<'PY'
import re, sys
rec, cp, t0, t1, home = sys.argv[1:]
rows = [l.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for l in open(rec)]
sysc = [r for r in rows if len(r) == 9 and r[0] == "SYSCALL" and r[5] == cp]
print("child-syscall-row: count=%d" % len(sysc), end="")
if len(sysc) == 1:
    r = sysc[0]
    kv = r[8].split(" ")
    print(" key=%s exe=%s uid=%s syscall59=%d success-yes=%d" % (r[7], r[6], r[4], "syscall=59" in kv, "success=yes" in kv))
    ser = r[2]
    mine = [x for x in rows if len(x) == 9 and x[2] == ser]
    types = {x[0] for x in mine}
    execve = [x for x in mine if x[0] == "EXECVE"]
    print("same-event: syscall=%d execve=%d cwd=%d path=%d execve-a0=%d" % ("SYSCALL" in types, "EXECVE" in types, "CWD" in types, "PATH" in types,
          int(bool(execve) and 'a0="/usr/bin/true"' in execve[0][8])))
    print("timestamp-in-window=%d" % (int(t0) - 2000 <= int(r[1]) <= int(t1) + 2000))
    payload = 'audit(%d.%03d:%s): auid=%s uid=%s pid=%s exe="%s" key="%s" %s' % (int(r[1]) // 1000, int(r[1]) % 1000, r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7], r[8])
    open(home + "/payload.txt", "w").write(payload)
    open(home + "/row.txt", "w").write("\t".join(r) + "\n")

    print()
print("columns-ok=%d" % all(len(r) == 9 for r in rows))
print("unknown-rows-typed=%d" % all(re.match(r"audit_type=\d+ ", r[8]) for r in rows if len(r) == 9 and r[0] == "UNKNOWN"))
PY

fi

cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
W=/run/w6-audit; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$W"
/usr/bin/cat >"$W/inner.sh" <<'INNER_EOF'
export HOME=/run/w6-audit PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin
cd "$HOME"
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
OR=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-audit-nl.py
nl() { /usr/bin/python3 -I "$OR" "$@"; }
jget() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.loads(sys.argv[1])[sys.argv[2]])' "$1" "$2"; }
stable() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); [d.pop(k) for k in ("lost","backlog","mask")]; print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))' "$1"; }
SNAP=$HOME/audit-snap.json

trap 'nl restore "$SNAP" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT

nl set enabled=0 >/dev/null
nl add '{"flags":4,"action":2,"syscalls":[59],"fields":[],"key":"mig-w6-ev"}' >/dev/null
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$HOME/nap"; exec 7<>"$HOME/nap"
nap() { read -t "$1" -u 7; }
ms() { echo $(( ${EPOCHREALTIME/./} / 1000 )); }
pdone() { echo "$1: pid-after=$(jget "$(nl status)" pid)"; }
cnt() { local n=0; while IFS= read -r _; do n=$((n+1)); done <"$1"; echo $n; }
f=$HOME/c.tsv

done

rc=$?

/usr/bin/rm -rf "$W"
exit $rc

count-bound: rc=0 printed=3 rows=3 before-deadline=1
count-bound: pid-after=0
time-bound: rc=0 printed-equals-rows=1 elapsed-in-1.0-3.5s=1
time-bound: pid-after=0
